classes.tenant: Company-owned rows: add company_id (NOT NULL, default from request context), FK, index, RLS select/insert/update/delete.
classes.tenant_config: Company-owned configuration: same as tenant, plus unique(company_id) or unique(company_id, key). Replaces global singletons.
classes.tenant_existing_company_id: Already has company_id text. Add FK to companies(id) and RLS; keep values ('sunchaser').
classes.identity: Global identity table; visibility to a company only via company_memberships.
classes.role_template: System rows (company_id NULL) readable by all; company rows isolated.
classes.dormant: Feature not enabled in production. No tenant access until a scoping review is done.
classes.sunchaser_only: Module owned by the founding company. No tenant access; routes blocked for other companies.
classes.rollback_artefact: Created only by a rollback script to keep a copy of removed data. No tenant access; excluded from company export; never part of the application schema.
classes.tenant_system: Company-owned rows written only by SECURITY DEFINER functions (for example numbering counters). Has company_id; the tenant role has no privilege on the table; included in company export.
classes.platform: Platform-owned table created by a SaaS migration (companies, memberships). Privileges are set by that migration, not by the generated tenant policies; not part of the tenant attack matrix; not exported as one company's data.

bank_accounts.note: Currently a global singleton. Becomes one row per company (unique on company_id).

bills.note: Finance record, provisional class tenant. Production-only: not defined in tracked SQL. On a synthetic bills the foundation migration adds company_id, row security and the reference trigger (scripts/rehearsal/run-saas-rehearsal.sh); its unique bill_number stays GLOBAL until the real definition is read and a per-company key is added.
bills.verify: Not defined in tracked SQL. Production schema must be read before migration.
